description_sq:
💥Ne nje nga komplekset familjare me te kerkuar ne Tirane ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1.
💶 175 000 €
📐Me nje siperfaqe totale 68 m2 por e mireshfrytezuar ne cdo pjese te saj apartamenti organizohet si me poshte:
-Sallon se bashku me kendin e gatimit
-2 dhoma gjumi
-1 tualet
-Ballkon
🔸️Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 10 (i parafundit) me pamje te lire nga veri-perendimi dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
🔸️Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
🔸️Kompleksi Magnet eshte nje nga komplekset me te kerkuar per jetesen familjare duke perfshire cdo fasilitet te mundshem per nje jetese sa me komode.
🔸️Kerkesa e larte per banim dhe per qiramarrje gjithashtu e bejne kete prone ideale si per banim ashtu dhe per investim.
description_en: 💥 In one of the most sought-after family complexes in Tirana, we offer for sale a 2+1 typology apartment. 💶 175,000 € 📐 With a total area of ​​68 m2 but well used in every part of it, the apartment is organized as follows: - Living room with kitchenette - 2 bedrooms - 1 toilet - Balcony 🔸️ The apartment is located on the 10th floor (penultimate) with a clear view from the north-west and is sold furnished as in the photo. 🔸️It has regular mortgage documentation 🔸️The Magnet complex is one of the most sought-after complexes for family living, including every possible facility for a comfortable life. 🔸️The high demand for housing and renting also make this property ideal for both housing and investment.
